meta.name: postgresql-table-design
meta.description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features

copy.tagline: 设计出规范高效的Postgres表结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用设计或审查Postgres表结构,并希望用上实践验证过的方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing PostgreSQL table schemas and want practical guidance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在设计或审查 PostgreSQL 表结构时会按技能内的规则行事:定主键、选数据类型、加约束与索引、判断是否分区,并给出可直接用的建表 DDL 示例。
howto.when: 当你要设计新的 PostgreSQL schema、在它上线前做审查,或为某张表选列类型、索引、分区方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 PostgreSQL 的用户表,给出建表 DDL
say.note: 会输出含主键、NOT NULL、索引的 DDL

say.text: 审查这个 PostgreSQL schema,看索引和数据类型有没有问题
say.note: 会指出缺 FK 索引、类型选错等问题

say.text: 这张表上亿行、查询总按时间过滤,该怎么分区?
say.note: 会给出 RANGE 分区方案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows this skill's rules when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL schema: choosing primary keys, data types, constraints and indexes, judging whether to partition, and producing ready-to-run DDL.
howto.when_en: Use it when designing a new PostgreSQL schema, reviewing one before it ships, or choosing column types, indexes, or partitioning for a specific table.

say_en.text: Design a PostgreSQL users table and give me the DDL
say_en.note: Outputs DDL with PK, NOT NULL, indexes

say_en.text: Review this PostgreSQL schema for index and data-type issues
say_en.note: Flags missing FK indexes and wrong types

say_en.text: This table has 100M+ rows and queries filter by time — how to partition it?
